comment: Thresholds of the icon registry (T-E44, `jjv icons`). The colour/hue values are the SAME numbers as recipes/qa/review-gates-v001.json q2_icons (a test pins them equal, so the registry gate and the review gate Q2 cannot drift apart). max_silhouette_iou is the shape half of the G-ICON-ART rule 'opposite pairs look opposite in colour AND shape' (measured on the 64x64 alpha masks); its value is calibrated in the tests on the real ep04 warm/cold pair.
